# Vendored Opus + Ogg

C sources for local SPM package `OpusOgg` (`Package.swift` in this directory).

- **opus** 1.5.2 — https://downloads.xiph.org/releases/opus/opus-1.5.2.tar.gz
- **libogg** 1.3.5 — https://downloads.xiph.org/releases/ogg/libogg-1.3.5.tar.gz

Float (non-`FIXED_POINT`) build only; arch-specific SIMD directories omitted.
